component.name: MainScene
component.script:
' ── config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ' Change BASE_URL to your machine's LAN IP when running on a real Roku device. ' (Roku cannot reach 127.0.0.1 on your PC — use e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080) CONST BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
CONST TABS = ["Pipelines", "Cloud", "Notifs", "Echo AI", "Diagnostics", "Live TV"] CONST REFRESH_SECS = 30 ' auto-refresh interval
' colours CONST C_BG = "0x0D1117FF" ' deep github dark CONST C_HEADER = "0x161B22FF" CONST C_TAB_IDLE = "0x21262DFF" CONST C_TAB_SEL = "0x238636FF" ' github green CONST C_TAB_IPTV = "0xBD2D0EFF" ' red accent for Live TV CONST C_TEXT = "0xE6EDF3FF" CONST C_SUBTEXT = "0x8B949EFF" CONST C_BORDER = "0x30363DFF"
' ── init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub init() m.activeTab = 0 m.isPlaying = false m.currentCh = invalid buildUI() setupVideoPlayer() setupTimer() showPanel(0) focusTabStrip() end sub
' ── UI construction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub buildUI() ' full-screen background bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 720 bg.color = C_BG
buildHeader() buildTabStrip() buildPanels() buildFooter() end sub
sub buildHeader() bar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bar.translation = [0, 0] bar.width = 1280 bar.height = 68 bar.color = C_HEADER
title = m.top.createChild("Label") title.translation = [40, 14] title.text = "⬛ MasterChief DevOps" title.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" title.color = C_TEXT
sep = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep.translation = [0, 68] sep.width = 1280 sep.height = 2 sep.color = C_BORDER
m.clockLabel = m.top.createChild("Label") m.clockLabel.translation = [1050, 22] m.clockLabel.text = "" m.clockLabel.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.clockLabel.color = C_SUBTEXT
updateClock() end sub
sub buildTabStrip() m.tabRects = [] m.tabLabels = [] tabY = 70 tabH = 52 tabW = 1280 / TABS.count()
for i = 0 to TABS.count() - 1 isLive = (i = 5) r = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") r.translation = [i * tabW, tabY] r.width = tabW - 2 r.height = tabH r.color = C_TAB_IDLE m.tabRects.push(r)
lbl = m.top.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [i * tabW + 12, tabY + 13] lbl.text = iif(isLive, "📺 " + TABS[i], TABS[i]) lbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" lbl.color = C_SUBTEXT m.tabLabels.push(lbl) end for
' separator below tab strip sep2 = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep2.translation = [0, tabY + tabH] sep2.width = 1280 sep2.height = 2 sep2.color = C_BORDER end sub
sub buildPanels() ' Lazy-create panel components; all start hidden m.panels = [ createPanel("PipelinesPanel"), createPanel("CloudPanel"), createPanel("NotifsPanel"), createPanel("EchoPanel"), createPanel("DiagPanel"), createIPTVPanel() ] end sub
function createPanel(compName as String) as Object p = m.top.createChild(compName) p.translation = [0, 124] p.visible = false return p end function
function createIPTVPanel() as Object p = m.top.createChild("IPTVPanel") p.translation = [0, 124] p.visible = false p.observeField("selectedChannel", "onChannelSelected") return p end function
sub buildFooter() bar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bar.translation = [0, 694] bar.width = 1280 bar.height = 26 bar.color = C_HEADER
hint = m.top.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [40, 698] hint.text = "◀ ▶ Switch tab ▲▼ Scroll panel * Refresh now Back / Home to exit" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = C_SUBTEXT end sub
' ── video player ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub setupVideoPlayer() m.video = m.top.createChild("Video") m.video.translation = [0, 0] m.video.width = 1280 m.video.height = 720 m.video.visible = false m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.video.observeField("errorInfo", "onVideoError")
m.npOverlay = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.npOverlay.translation = [0, 656] m.npOverlay.width = 1280 m.npOverlay.height = 64 m.npOverlay.color = "0x000000BB" m.npOverlay.visible = false
m.npTitle = m.top.createChild("Label") m.npTitle.translation = [40, 664] m.npTitle.text = "" m.npTitle.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" m.npTitle.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.npTitle.visible = false
m.npHint = m.top.createChild("Label") m.npHint.translation = [900, 674] m.npHint.text = "Back = stop ▲▼ volume" m.npHint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.npHint.color = "0xCCCCCCCC" m.npHint.visible = false
m.loadingLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.loadingLbl.translation = [400, 332] m.loadingLbl.text = "Connecting to stream..." m.loadingLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" m.loadingLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.loadingLbl.visible = false end sub
sub onChannelSelected() ch = m.panels[5].selectedChannel if ch = invalid then return if ch.url = "" then return m.currentCh = ch playChannel(ch) end sub
sub playChannel(ch as Dynamic) m.isPlaying = true content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = ch.url url = LCase(ch.url) if Instr(1, url, ".m3u8") > 0 or Instr(1, url, "hls") > 0 content.streamFormat = "hls" else if Instr(1, url, ".mpd") > 0 content.streamFormat = "dash" else if Instr(1, url, ".mp4") > 0 content.streamFormat = "mp4" else if Instr(1, url, ".ts") > 0 content.streamFormat = "ts" else content.streamFormat = "hls" end if content.title = ch.name m.video.content = content m.video.visible = true m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) for i = 0 to m.panels.count() - 1 m.panels[i].visible = false end for m.npTitle.text = "▶ " + ch.name m.npTitle.visible = true m.npOverlay.visible = true m.npHint.visible = true m.loadingLbl.text = "Connecting to stream..." m.loadingLbl.visible = true end sub
sub stopPlayback() m.isPlaying = false m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false m.npOverlay.visible = false m.npTitle.visible = false m.npHint.visible = false m.loadingLbl.visible = false showPanel(5) m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onVideoState() state = m.video.state if state = "buffering" m.loadingLbl.text = "Buffering..." m.loadingLbl.visible = true else if state = "playing" m.loadingLbl.visible = false else if state = "stopped" or state = "finished" if m.isPlaying then stopPlayback() end if end sub
sub onVideoError() info = m.video.errorInfo if info <> invalid msg = "" if info.doesExist("errorMsg") then msg = info.errorMsg m.loadingLbl.text = "Stream error: " + msg m.loadingLbl.visible = true end if end sub
' ── tab switching ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub showPanel(idx as Integer) for i = 0 to m.panels.count() - 1 isActive = (i = idx) isLive = (i = 5) m.panels[i].visible = isActive if isActive m.tabRects[i].color = iif(isLive, C_TAB_IPTV, C_TAB_SEL) m.tabLabels[i].color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.tabRects[i].color = C_TAB_IDLE m.tabLabels[i].color = "0x8B949EFF" end if end for m.activeTab = idx m.panels[idx].callFunc("load", {}) end sub
' ── timer (clock + auto-refresh) ────────────────────────────────────────── sub setupTimer() m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "onTick") m.timer.control = "start" m.tickCount = 0 end sub
sub onTick() m.tickCount = m.tickCount + 1 updateClock() ' skip auto-refresh for IPTV tab (heavy) and when video is playing if m.tickCount mod REFRESH_SECS = 0 and not m.isPlaying and m.activeTab < 5 m.panels[m.activeTab].callFunc("load", {}) end if end sub
sub updateClock() dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() h = dt.GetHours() min = dt.GetMinutes() sec = dt.GetSeconds() m.clockLabel.text = RightPad(h) + ":" + RightPad(min) + ":" + RightPad(sec) end sub
function RightPad(n as Integer) as String s = str(n).trim() if len(s) = 1 then s = "0" + s return s end function
' ── key handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub focusTabStrip() m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
' while video is playing, Back stops it; let Video handle everything else if m.isPlaying if key = "back" stopPlayback() return true end if return false end if
if key = "left" if m.activeTab > 0 showPanel(m.activeTab - 1) end if return true else if key = "right" if m.activeTab < TABS.count() - 1 showPanel(m.activeTab + 1) end if return true else if key = "replay" ' * button = refresh now (not IPTV) if m.activeTab < 5 m.panels[m.activeTab].callFunc("load", {}) end if return true end if return false end function
